The '''Eastern Arch Platoon''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] military group on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]]. It was commanded by [[Ton E'rau]].
